crossRefs.note: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is…
My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

translations.web: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
translations.bsb: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.
translations.kjv: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
translations.asv: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.
